coordinate_contract.mapping: CAD coordinates = working coordinates * scale; origin unchanged

representation: DXF: grouped planar curves; STEP/IGES: planar faces with hole wires; no solids or native dimensional constraint/history tree
orientation_contract: STEP/IGES face normal +Z, outer wires CCW and hole wires CW; source traversal remains in selected_model, face reversals in entity_mapping. Readers may reparameterize native curves.

complexity.degree_note: Çember/elips: örtük derece; Fourier: 0 polinom dışı anlamındadır, harmonik sayısı katsayılardan bilinir; diğerleri: parametrik polinom derecesi.
complexity.parameter_count_note: Paylaşılan uç/periodiklik kısıtları düşülmemiş üst sayım.

certification.coefficient_semantics: stored binary64 values interpreted as exact dyadic rationals
certification.rational_arc_semantics: positive homogeneous quadratic Bernstein; exact shared dyadic endpoints
certification.full_conic_semantics: canonical full-turn interval; exact symbolic 2*pi phase, dyadic radii and rotation angle

transfer_validation.scope: CAD okuyucusundan tekrar alınan geometri; float64 kontrollü poligonlar. Kaynak model sertifikasından ayrıdır.

original_model_certificate_scope: source model and normalized pixel reference; does not certify the CAD file
